description: This file defines the Formatter class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for formatting numerical, date, percentage, and text values according to Excel-style format strings. It includes methods for parsing format strings, handling different formatting sections, and converting values to display strings.

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: A utility class for converting Excel-style number and date formats into PHP formatted strings, supporting multiple sections, colors, and conditional formatting logic.

methods.name: toFormattedString
methods.description: Converts a value to a formatted string based on a given format string, handling text, numbers, dates, percentages, and custom formats, optionally applying callback formatting.
